risk_summary: The company has limited operating activity and relies on uncertain royalties, milestones, and a future acquisition to monetize approximately $103.4 million of NOLs. Regulatory setbacks, expiring royalty rights, pandemic-related disruptions, and the absence of identified acquisition candidates create material uncertainty around future revenue and NOL utilization. The extensive forward-looking disclaimers and repeated inability-to-assure language reinforce a cautious risk profile.
